g.text: Build the rig before any fighter
Glass Joe through it: flat wedges, no elbow
Von Kaiser through it at heavier proportions
Rig holds for a second fighter?
Still looks like paper: split arms, add knees, shade the torso
Impact particles bury the hit; wrong call
Hand-tune freeze, shake, buzz, on a phone
Delete splash, mode select, fighter select, tutorial: 22s to 6s
Cut webcam hand-tracking; wrong for a couch
Live; tuning the star punch now
